title.zh: 共享存量上的汲取：每种组合都在存量之内，当且仅当总和在内
title.en: Draws on one shared stock: every combination fits exactly when the total does

claim.zh: 前 n 项以自然数给出的汲取中，每一种选取都在存量之内，当且仅当它们的总和在存量之内。
claim.en: Of the first n draws, given as natural numbers, every selection fits within the stock exactly when their total does.

hypotheses.zh: 汲取是可相加的自然数；存量是它们共同汲取的同一个量。
hypotheses.en: The draws are natural numbers that add; the stock is the one quantity they all draw on.

correspondence.zh: 在源模型中，每项汲取是一项活动无过渡损失地停止所需的工作，存量是为此留出的部分。这些数不是一般的价值度量；与实际活动和存量的对应需另行核实。
correspondence.en: In the source model, each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss, and the stock is what is set aside for that work. The numbers are not a general measure of value; their correspondence to actual activities and stocks needs separate evidence.

detail.zh: 支持身份与可加总量不同，没有已证通用转换。
detail.en: Support identity differs from additive quantity; no verified general adapter.

detail.zh: 静态总量条件不提供动态方案的观察与作用覆盖。
detail.en: A static total does not supply a dynamic plan’s observation and effect coverage.

detail.zh: 每项单独在内不推出共同在内：两项各为二单位的汲取可以竞争同一个二单位的存量。
detail.en: Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.

limitations.zh: 每项单独在内不推出共同在内：两项各为二单位的汲取可以竞争同一个二单位的存量。
limitations.en: Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 汲取在同一共享存量上相加之处可直接复用；其他支持类型需明确转换或另证。
next_delta.en: Reuse wherever draws add on one shared stock; other kinds of support need a stated translation or a separate proof.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-10：按 Ren 的要求以描述结构的词重述（原题“可加退出承担的共同资金界”）；主张、证明与回执不变。
history.en: 2026-10-10: restated in words that describe the structure, at Ren's request (formerly “Joint funding of additive exit obligations”); claim, proof and receipt unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-10：按 Ren 的要求改用描述结构的内部名称：记录 ID 由 aggregate-exit-funding 改为 draws-on-a-shared-stock（旧 ID 留作别名，以便历史检查仍能找到），Lean 定理 all_coalitions_funded_iff_joint_total 与 individually_affordable_exits_can_fail_jointly 改名为 every_selection_within_iff_total_within 与 each_within_alone_not_together，参数 claims、reserve 改为 draws、stock；两项 Lean 检查重新运行并通过，证明内容不变。
history.en: 2026-10-10: internal names restated in structural words at Ren's request. The record ID aggregate-exit-funding became draws-on-a-shared-stock, with the old ID kept as an alias so historical checks still resolve; the Lean theorems all_coalitions_funded_iff_joint_total and individually_affordable_exits_can_fail_jointly became every_selection_within_iff_total_within and each_within_alone_not_together, with parameters claims and reserve renamed draws and stock. Both Lean checks were rerun and passed; the proofs are unchanged.
